context.target_user: Clinicians, attorneys, and technical professionals writing educational marketing
context.problem: Translating dense clinical or legal jargon into accessible Grade 7-8 reading levels.
context.use_case: Immediate post-draft syntactic editing to highlight hard-to-read sentences and passive voice.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 05, Hemingway Editor detected Grade 15 medical jargon and passive voice, enabling reduction to Grade 8 accessible prose in under 2 minutes. Conditioned on editorial oversight to ensure syntactic simplification does not compromise medical accuracy.
when_to_consider: When simplifying technical professional prose for consumer/patient audiences.
When rapid, zero-setup visual readability feedback is needed.
when_not_to_use: As a fact-checker or medical compliance validator (it has zero factual awareness).
